purpose: Give mutually exclusive alternatives for one composition role a named, discoverable home with recorded selection knowledge, without creating a second cardinality authority beside composition.rules.json.

distinction.functional_bundle: Components that join into one capability unit; all declared members are meant to coexist.
distinction.choice_bundle: A register of alternatives for one role; a bounded number of candidates is meant to be selected, usually exactly one or at most one.
distinction.chosen_selection_lives_in: deployment.profile (ontology term) and the stack component role assignment, not in the choice bundle.

cardinality_authority.rule: choice_groups[].role_ref MUST name an existing composition.rules role; every candidate ref MUST be listed in that role's providers.
cardinality_authority.narrowing_example: A role with minimum 0 and maximum 1 permits a group with pick exactly-one: the role says 'at most one may exist', the group says 'in this context you need one'.

schema_extension.version_bump_reason: The pinned canonical resolver rejects any bundle manifest whose schema string is not exactly 'ellmos.bundle.v1' (system-explorer@b3e1986b24085d4b0083facbdc38c06cb633ba05, component_registry._load_bundle). The extension is therefore additive and optional; every pre-existing v1 manifest stays valid unchanged.

entry_fields.min: optional integer; derived from pick when absent, mandatory for pick range
entry_fields.max: optional integer; derived from pick when absent, mandatory for pick range
entry_fields.default_selection: optional candidate ref or list of refs; the group-level view of the preselection
entry_fields.selection_notes: free text; MUST state open questions instead of inventing criteria

cardinality_fields.purpose: pick is the readable short form for the two common cases; min/max express the general case, so a group is not limited to XOR.
cardinality_fields.derivation: exactly-one implies min 1 max 1; at-most-one implies min 0 max 1; range derives nothing and requires both.
cardinality_fields.role_bound: min/max must stay inside the role's own minimum/maximum. A group may narrow within the role; it may never widen beyond it.
cardinality_fields.current_reach: Every role in composition.rules currently has maximum 1, so today no group can legitimately declare max > 1. The fields are validated and ready; the first genuine multi-pick needs a role with maximum > 1, which is a change to the cardinality authority and belongs to its owner.
cardinality_fields.default_selection_rule: Must name candidates of the same group and must agree with the candidates carrying default: true. For groups with more than one preselected candidate it is the only correct form.

candidate_fields.type: module | stack | skill | software_app | access_surface | external
candidate_fields.identity: optional ontological reference where it differs from ref, e.g. 'stack:roshambo-stack'
candidate_fields.default: boolean, at most one true per group
candidate_fields.registered_in_bundle: optional bundle id, or null when the candidate is not a member of any bundle yet
candidate_fields.evidence: source references for the recorded criteria

choice_bundle_refs.purpose: Nesting: a functional bundle points at a choice bundle whose role affects it.

entry_fields.content_hash: pinned hash of the referenced manifest

rejected_alternative.option: component entry with type 'bundle' inside components[]
rejected_alternative.rejected_because: COMPONENT_TYPES in the pinned canonical resolver is a closed enum without 'bundle' (system-explorer@b3e1986b24085d4b0083facbdc38c06cb633ba05, contracts.COMPONENT_TYPES). A bundle-typed component would make every affected manifest fail contract validation.
rejected_alternative.upstream_step_required_before_reconsider: extend COMPONENT_TYPES and COMPONENT_REF_PREFIXES in ellmos-ai/system-explorer, then repin contracts/component-registry-resolution-contract.v1.json

catalog_class.meaning: Pure selection register. Not a deployment unit.
catalog_class.resolution_rule: A choice bundle is not required to be referenced by any stack or system; deployment resolution counts functional classes only.
catalog_class.enum_check: The pinned catalog validator does not constrain class values, so this class needs no upstream change.

placement_rule.question: Does a choice group live inside the functional bundle, or does it get its own choice bundle?
inside_the_functional_bundle_when: at least one candidate is a declared component of that bundle, and
no candidate is a declared component of a different bundle, and
that bundle is not hash-pinned by an approval gate
own_choice_bundle_when: the candidates live in different bundles, so there is no single home
a candidate is not a bundle member at all, for example a stack or an external service
the only thematically fitting bundle is hash-pinned by an approval gate
placement_rule.approval_gate_reason: manifests/module-readme-discovery.approvals.v1.json pins exact bundle content hashes with default_action deny. Adding a selection register to such a manifest would silently invalidate a granted approval, so the register is placed elsewhere and the omission is recorded at the pointer.
placement_rule.rationale: The sparse variant is preferred: a choice group inside an existing bundle costs no catalog entry. A separate choice bundle is spent only where a single home does not exist or must not be touched.

selection_knowledge_rule.no_invention: Criteria must be traceable to module manifests, READMEs, catalogs or architecture documents. Where a difference is not documented, selection_notes records an explicit TODO instead of a plausible-sounding claim.

checks: candidates are a subset of the role providers
at most one default per group unless default_selection lists them explicitly
pick value is valid, and pick range carries explicit min and max
min/max are non-negative, min does not exceed max, max does not exceed the candidate count
min/max stay inside the role's minimum/maximum
default_selection names candidates of the same group and agrees with the default flags
choice_bundle_refs resolve to an existing manifest of catalog class choice
